question.text: Research entity compensation of analysts must NOT be based on:

answer.text: Specific merchant banking or investment banking or brokerage services transactions
Years of experience of the analyst

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 276 of the NISM XV workbook directly prohibits research analyst compensation from being based on any specific merchant banking, investment banking, or brokerage services transaction. Pages 276-277 also require the board or an appointed committee to review and document compensation annually. The Trap: The rule is a prohibition on the specific transactional basis listed. The workbook pages do not affirmatively state that the other listed bases (firm profitability, research quality, years of experience) are permitted — so do not infer permission from this regulation alone. Note: Source-backed by Regulation 17 wording on pages 276-277 of NISM Series XV Research Analyst Workbook (February 2026).
